title: W-18: trust-store environment variables are untested (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR)
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-18 (low). The suite covers NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 only, so the claim that the system store is the only trust store is unproven for the compiled binary. Exploiting it needs a network position, and same-user injection is conceded. Files: src/adapters/https-transport.ts, test/transport.test.ts, guard.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A probe sets each variable to a harness CA and asserts the handshake is refused, or guard.ts scrubs them and a test asserts it
